newsitem.title: FRANCE: French consumer spending seen up 0.8 pct in Jan.
newsitem.headline: French consumer spending seen up 0.8 pct in Jan.

text.p: French consumer spending on manufactured goods is expected to show a rise of 0.8 percent in January from December, according to a Reuter poll of 11 economists on Monday.
The January data will be released at 0745 GMT on Wednesday.
Economists said that spending was likely to be helped by a late start to winter sales, which this year began in January, rather than immediately after Christmas.
Figures showing a rise in hypermarket sales in January also boosted expectations.

According to figures released by the Federation of Commercial and Distribution Companies on February 6, hypermarket sales rose 3.3 percent in value terms in January from January 1996, while supermarket sales rose 2.9 percent.
